source_sha_policy: Promotion requires one immutable merged source SHA, a verified deployment and independent production checks across routes, assets and release metadata.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

release_intent: Replace the fixed 66-record museum ceiling with a verified core plus an append-only, multilingual and cross-platform public universe that can grow without breaking the site.
promotion_gate: Do not call this production until the exact merged SHA is deployed and the public domain serves the expanding museum, JSON layer, styles, search, filters and source counts correctly on desktop and mobile.
rollback: The current immutable Vercel production and prior source commits remain available for rollback.
